subject.title: feat: serve signed publisher feed projections

question: Should the existing catalog-feed route be migrated to DSSE and fail closed as part of this publisher-feed PR, or must this PR preserve the current catalog representation until a separately approved rollout is ready?
rationale: The answer changes a public client contract, a production secret dependency, and the acceptable outage behavior; source review cannot determine whether maintainers intend that coordinated rollout.

options.title: Split and preserve the catalog route
options.body: Rebase after the prerequisite PRs land and keep the existing catalog handler unchanged while adding only the signed publisher routes.

options.title: Approve a coordinated catalog cutover
options.body: Accept the DSSE catalog migration only with explicit consumer compatibility, production secret provisioning, rollback, and live endpoint proof.

options.title: Pause the feed stack
options.body: Defer this public contract until the feed distribution and signing rollout has an approved owner and deployment plan.

recommendation.title: Split and preserve the catalog route
recommendation.body: Rebase after the prerequisite PRs land and keep the existing catalog handler unchanged while adding only the signed publisher routes.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior publisher-feed contract review makes Patrick-Erichsen the best available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
